card.name: Language names in encyclopedia entries
card.fires_on: The word language, or a word just before it, in short encyclopedia-style descriptions of a language or dialect and where it is spoken. Also fires on commas and articles in gazetteer entries for places.

modes.label: Language descriptions
modes.description: The word language or a family or dialect term in a definition of a tongue and its region.
modes.example: A Chadic<< language>> spoken south of Lake Chad.

modes.label: Words before dialect or language
modes.description: Linking or modifying words right before a language or dialect noun.
modes.example: to say nothing of the<< minor>> dialects, are spoken on the streets

modes.label: Place entry openers
modes.description: Commas or articles in dictionary-style entries for places, before a descriptive phrase.
modes.example: Akrotiri Sovereign Base Area<<,>> or Western Sovereign Base Area, British

card.writes: It pushes toward words like important and local, plus a few Chinese words meaning important.
card.plain: It lights up in encyclopedia-style text that describes a language and where it is spoken.
